# Indigenous Rights Center

> A nonprofit organization in Albuquerque, New Mexico dedicated to advancing indigenous rights, language preservation, and social justice for Native American communities.

The Indigenous Rights Center focuses on protecting indigenous peoples' rights and cultural heritage, with particular emphasis on Native American language revitalization programs in partnership with tribal nations like the Navajo Nation and Muscogee Creek Nation. The organization serves as an advocacy hub for indigenous communities across New Mexico and beyond.

- [Rosetta Stone and Navajo Nation Partnership](https://indigenousrightscenter.org/2022/02/rosetta-stone-endangered-language-program): Rosetta Stone partnership for Navajo language revitalization
- [Mvskoke Language Program](https://indigenousrightscenter.org/2022/02/mvskoke-language-program): Mvskoke language preservation program with Muscogee Creek Nation
- [Native American Languages in New Mexico](https://indigenousrightscenter.org/2022/02/native-american-languages-in-new-mexico): Overview of indigenous languages in New Mexico Pueblo communities
